_note: The interface languages of ScriptureStudy Pro. Every announcement must exist in every one. Keep in step with ScriptureStudy_macOS/ScriptureStudy/Localizable.xcstrings: run tools/generate_announcements.py --check --app-strings <that file>.
_languageFilterMinVersion: The first app version that understands a post's `languages` field. A post for chosen languages must have minVersion at least this, because older apps ignore the field and would show the post to everyone. Ship the build that adds the filter as exactly this version (or change this value to match).
